title: docs: DEVIN_ROADMAP.md + CLAUDE_ROADMAP.md — full audit, MVP plan, AI-native track, Claude Code operating manual
body:
## Summary

Adds two foundational documents at the repo root:

1. **`DEVIN_ROADMAP.md`** — the full product + architectural roadmap. Codebase audit, MVP plan, post-MVP AI track, all decisions.
2. **`CLAUDE_ROADMAP.md`** — Claude Code's operating manual. Workflow, code-quality rules, definition of done, what NOT to do without approval, Phase 0 starting checklist.

These are pure docs — no code changes, no behaviour changes. They define the *what* (DEVIN) and the *how* (CLAUDE) for every PR from this point forward.

## Type of change

- [x] 📝 Docs (`docs/`) — documentation only

## What's in `DEVIN_ROADMAP.md` (v5, ~1000 lines)

- **§1 Codebase audit** of `lib/db`, `artifacts/api-server`, `artifacts/campus-music-mobile`, `artifacts/campus-music` (legacy → admin candidate), root configs. Per-table column inventory, per-route inventory, per-screen real-vs-faked breakdown.
- **§2 MVP roadmap** covering every UI-visible feature (no cuts): Auth, Artist Profile, Listener Profile, Live Now (real audio + chat), **Campus Music TV** (new editorial flywheel), Music Feed, Comments / Likes / Shares / Reposts, Notifications, Discovery, Direct Messages, Podcasts, Playlists, Admin Panel, Backend Completeness, Infrastructure, **AI-native foundations** (in MVP) + AI features (post-MVP).
- **§3 Architecture decisions** (§3.1–§3.20):
  - Storage: Cloudflare R2 (audio, zero egress) + Supabase Storage (images), both behind Cloudflare CDN with signed URLs.
  - Multi-bitrate AAC transcoding (96k/160k/320k) via Fly.io ffmpeg worker.
  - Live audio: LiveKit Cloud (interactive WebRTC).
  - Live broadcast video (Campus Music TV): Cloudflare Stream (RTMPS → HLS) with auto-VOD.
  - Hosting: Fly.io API (`iad` + `lax`) + Vercel admin SPA.
  - Realtime: Socket.io behind a `RealtimeGateway` interface.
  - Email: Resend with DKIM/SPF/DMARC.
  - Migrations: versioned SQL files (no `drizzle-kit push` in production).
  - **§3.19 AI-native architecture** — `pgvector` audio embeddings on every upload, Demucs stems separation, structured lyrics (LRC + lyric embeddings), `ai_jobs` queue + `ai-worker` Fly app, pluggable `AIProvider` interface, `ai_credits` ledger, `ai_generations` provenance, granular `ai_consent` opt-in, safety classifier on AI text outputs.
- **§4 Phased plan** — Phases 0 through 11.5 (~21.5 weeks for MVP), then Phases 12–17 (~14 weeks of post-MVP AI track):
  - **Phase 0** Foundations
  - **Phase 1** Real Auth (incl. migrate off Replit)
  - **Phase 2** Profiles + Storage + Audio Pipeline + **AI Foundations**
  - **Phase 3** Music Feed + Social Graph
  - **Phase 4** WebSocket Gateway + DMs
  - **Phase 5** Live Now + Live → MP3 auto-publish (the killer artist-discovery feature)
  - **Phase 6** Notifications (in-app + push)
  - **Phase 7** Discovery overhaul (FTS + Now Listening + Trending)
  - **Phase 8** Podcasts
  - **Phase 9** Playlists
  - **Phase 10** Admin Web
  - **Phase 10.5** **Campus Music TV** (editorial flywheel — Trending Artists / Studio Interviews / Daily Show / Takeovers)
  - **Phase 11** Production Hardening + soft launch
  - **Phase 12** AI Foundations harden + Recs v1
  - **Phase 13** Studio Assistants (Pen Pal + Cover Studio + Beat Lab + Demo Polish)
  - **Phase 14** **Cross-Campus Collab Studio "Sessions"** — the moat
  - **Phase 15** AI A&R Weekly Brief + Ask Campus + Lyric Tagging + Recs v2
  - **Phase 16** AI Karaoke + Mashup Studio + Translate-and-Cover + Cover Detection
  - **Phase 17** AI TV Producer + Live Captions + Edge AI + Trend Prediction
- **§5 What I would NOT build for MVP** (the explicit defer list).
- **§6 Decisions taken** — 19-row table with my position on every architectural question, all approved by Kofi.
- **§7 The Spotify / Apple-Music / AI gap** — post-MVP roadmap with explicit timing for each major item.

## What's in `CLAUDE_ROADMAP.md`

- **§0–§2** Workflow rules: one phase at a time, PR per phase, definition of done.
- **§3 Approved decisions table** (locked in by Kofi) — the single reference for "is this decision settled".
- **§4 Code quality rules** — TypeScript (strict, no `any`), RN/Expo, Express, DB (versioned SQL migrations), tests, security, git conventions.
- **§5 What you DO NOT do without approval** — schema changes outside the phase, vendor swaps, scope additions, breaking API changes, force pushes, mass refactors.
- **§6 When to flag blockers** — and how (PR comment / `blocker` issue).
- **§7 Tech stack reference** — pinned versions, approved providers.
- **§8 Phase plan** mirror.
- **§9 Phase 0 starting checklist** — Claude Code's exact deliverables for the first PR.
- **§10 Roles** — Claude Code (implementation) / Devin (architect, reviewer) / Kofi (product).

## Testing notes

Docs-only PR. No code change to test.

- [x] Typecheck passes (no code changed)
- [x] Verified locally — Markdown renders correctly in the GitHub preview

## Checklist

- [x] Branch follows naming convention (`docs/`)
- [x] No secrets committed
- [x] Self-reviewed the diff

## After this merges

Kofi will hand Claude Code a starter prompt pointing it at both files. Claude Code opens `claude/phase-0-foundations` and starts Phase 0. Devin (this session) stays on as the architect/reviewer.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/db416d2861a3475195e36b318e3b0c05
Requested by: @KofiGilbert
